evidence_surfaces.why_no_bulk: linear_list_issues returns no comments; the note that ties a row to a ticket needs that ticket's own linear_list_comments
evidence_surfaces.short_circuit: a row with a blank Ticket cell is only settled by reading candidate tickets; titles use other words, so one search cannot sweep the ties

evidence_surfaces.why_no_bulk: github_search_pull_requests returns neither reviews, inline comments nor conversation comments, and in:comments misses inline ones
evidence_surfaces.short_circuit: merged state alone does not say whether a fix is in a PR; only its own review and comment surfaces do, and each of the four PRs (#465, #472, #473, #475) needs them

evidence_surfaces.why_no_bulk: the sheet names builds by number only; the branch is in each build's own post, and 146 match3d posts in the last week of September cannot be read in one call
evidence_surfaces.short_circuit: a re-test only counts on a build of the main branch, so each of the 12 distinct builds in the Re-test column and the chat needs its branch

evidence_surfaces.why_no_bulk: one range read returns the rows; counted at a tenth because it is a bulk read
evidence_surfaces.short_circuit: the list itself; nothing else holds the rows
